name: Task or technical debt
about: Work on the code, the build, the tests or the documentation that changes no behavior a user sees.
title: ""
labels: tech-debt
---

## Context

What is wrong or missing today, and where (file, class, job). Why it is worth doing now, or what would make it worth doing.

## To do

The steps, in order. Say what is **left out** on purpose.

- [ ] ...

## Done when

A check anyone can run: a test that fails before and passes after, a number that moves (lines, score, time), a job that is
green. "Cleaner" is not a check.

## References

Links: related issues, the review finding (`C-nn`), the commit or the document that left it open.
